maya: Quick heads up — ran a paged-attn perf pass on the q4_0 Llama-2-13B path and hit a regression after yesterday's kernel selector change.

maya: Symptoms: KV page fragmentation metric doubled (allocated pages vs active pages) and the kernel chooser is falling back to flash_v1 for short sequences more often. Observed ~20% increase in p99 tail and ~12% throughput drop on steady-state batching.

maya: Repro command (local):
```
tools/run_paged_attn_bench --model llama2-13b --quant q4_0 --seq 1024 --batch 16 --workers 4 --kv-pages 64 --trace ./out/kv_trace.pb
```

alex: ugh. is this correlated with the slab allocator tuning from yesterday? :thinking:

jon: can you share the flamegraphs / kernel selection logs? might be a routing threshold bug.

maya: pushed traces: https://internal.perf/trace/3732109876 (kvtables, kernel-choice logs). key excerpt:
```
[2025-06-17T14:02:01Z] kernel_select: preferring flash_v2 for seq>512, else flash_v1
[2025-06-17T14:02:02Z] kv_pager: slab_frag_ratio=0.62 -> eviction_trips++
[2025-06-17T14:02:02Z] block_table: hot_index_skew=0.37 -> prefer_sparse_locking
```

kai: hot_index_skew that high will blow up contiguous allocation. i'm guessing the allocator is returning smaller extents and causing more page objects.

rachel: try bumping per-shard slab target from 128k -> 256k. that reduced fragmentation in my local runs.

maya: i tried that — reduced alloc churn but p99 still +8%. looks like kernel fallback still happening because sequence-length distribution in batches has wider tail; selector's sample window may be stale.

jon: maybe selector uses median seq instead of p90. that would explain fallback. can you grep for "selector_window" in the logs?

maya: found it: "selector_window_ms=30000 sample_metric=median". switching sample_metric to p90 in the config fixed kernel choice in my quick demo and restored p99, but we need perf runs.

perf-bot: benchmark run queued: bench/3732109876-full (expected 45m). Will post results when complete.

alex: nice find. we should also add a cheap telemetry: percent of requests routed to fallback kernel per minute. helps catch regressions.

maya: agree. i'll open a small PR to emit that metric + expose slab target per-shard in console. assigning to @alex for allocator follow-up.

alex: picking this up. I'll run a sweep of slab sizes and KV page counts, and add a microbenchmark for hot_index_skew scenarios.

deploy-bot: canary rollout paused for kernel-selector-v2 due to perf alert (service=inference, rollout=kernel-selector-v2, status=paused)

maya: thanks deploy-bot. looping @eng-sre for visibility.

jon: quick TODOs: 1) run perf-bot result analysis 2) add p90 sampling in selector config 3) slab size sweep + microbench 4) add fallback-rate telemetry

maya: adding notes to the perf doc. thanks all :thumbsup:
